name: Xissai: The Snake Temple
source:
They weren't like the other kids.

Their skin was smooth like silk and never marred by imperfections. Their almond-shaped eyes had vertical pupils, and their color, blue and violet, was nothing like the townsfolk had ever seen.

The changes in their bodies deepened every year. When Sekhavel turned fifteen his canines started to grow longer, thinner, sharper resembling fangs. Seles was quick to follow, as if some mysterious curse ran through their veins, turning the twin brothers into monsters.

People gossiped they said that the two orphans had an eerie, turbulent aura about them, that they were possibly dangerous, possibly ill-fated.

That something had to be done. And it was, soon after they turned twenty.

The Celestial Serpent, Xisseth, was an odd deity. Depicted as a beautiful half-snake man with a gaze so piercing that it made those around him lose their wits, Xisseth was unlike any other monster that the realm had known.

He was alluring and irresistible, using his charms to lure people into his temple to offer them vitality and celestial essence in exchange for their faith. In his house, the Celestial Scale Palace, bodily pleasures that surpassed imagination were traded for a mystical bond that could only form between a true follower and their deity.

Two young orphans, Seles and Sekhavel, discover that they are Xissai, magical half-snake entities blessed by Xisseth himself and soon to become initiates in his temple. Abandoning their old lives, they know that they are throwing themselves into uncharted waters - but nothing could have prepared the two brothers for the reality that awaits them.

Xissai: The Snake Temple is a fantasy yaoi visual novel game for adults.  Follow the story of two half-snake brothers, Seles and Sekhavel, as they go about their very naughty duties as Xissai, priests in the temple of Xisseth - the Serpent God of Passion!

Your choices will influence their feelings and actions, making the two more inclined to either stay submissive and follow their faith or become rebellious and embrace their own desires.

But be careful - in this labyrinth of pleasure, love and mysterious rituals, ancient secrets lie buried deep beneath the stone.

[From [url=https://aedian-glair.itch.io/xissai]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他们和其他孩子不一样。

他们的皮肤光滑如丝，从未有过瑕疵；杏仁状的眼睛长着竖瞳，蓝色与紫色的瞳色更是镇民从未见过的。

他们身体的变化一年比一年明显。Sekhavel满15岁时，犬齿开始变长、变细、变尖，宛如獠牙。Seles很快也出现了同样的变化，仿佛某种神秘诅咒在两人血脉中流淌，将这对双胞胎兄弟变成怪物。

人们议论纷纷，说这两名孤儿身上有股诡异而躁动的气息，似乎十分危险，注定要遭逢厄运。

有人认为必须做些什么。在他们年满20岁后不久，这件事便发生了。

天蛇神Xisseth是一位奇异的神祇。人们将祂描绘成一名容貌俊美的半蛇男子，目光锐利，足以令人失去理智。祂是这个世界从未见过的异兽。

祂魅惑而令人难以抗拒，利用自身魅力引诱人们来到神殿，再以生命力和天界精华换取他们的信仰。在祂的居所天鳞宫，超乎想象的肉体欢愉可以换来神祇与真正信徒之间的神秘羁绊。

两名年轻孤儿Seles和Sekhavel发现自己是Xissai，是受Xisseth亲自赐福的半蛇魔法生物，很快就要成为神殿的见习祭司。他们抛下过去的生活，明知自己即将踏入未知领域，却仍未料到等待着兄弟俩的现实会是怎样一番景象。

《Xissai: The Snake Temple》是一部面向成人的奇幻耽美视觉小说。跟随半蛇兄弟Seles和Sekhavel，体验他们作为Xissai祭司在神殿履行那些荒淫职责的故事；Xisseth则是掌管激情的蛇神！

你的选择会影响他们的感情与行动，让他们更倾向于保持顺从、坚守信仰，或是反抗并拥抱自身欲望。

但请小心：在这座充满欢愉、爱情与神秘仪式的迷宫里，古老秘密深埋在石墙之下。

[引自[url=https://aedian-glair.itch.io/xissai]Itch.io[/url]]
